incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-9921 fired for hosted-inference: high 5xx rate (threshold: 3% over 5m). PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-9921


dave (eng-oncall): acknowledging — I’m awake, looking now.

sre_bot: auto-escalation timer started (0m). Next step: secondary after 2m.

carla (sre): seeing spike in 5xx on /v1/generate from eu-west-1 clusters. Rolling error sample: ``502, 502, 504, 502`` across hosts r-inf-03..r-inf-07. Any recent deploys?

dave (eng-oncall): no deploys in last hour per deploy-bot. Checking logs + metrics. Running quick query: ``SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE status >= 500 AND region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now()-10m``

ben (infra): I can reach the hosts but CPU on r-inf-05 is pegged 100% on process gpt-runtime. Could be OOM / kernelOOM? pulling `dmesg` now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9921 not acknowledged by primary within 2m, escalating to secondary carla (sre).

carla (sre): got the PD page, pinging on mobile now — I’m looking at kernel ooms on r-inf-05: ``[OOM] kill process 12456 gpt-runtime``. Host showing repeated container restarts.

dave (eng-oncall): attempting temp failover: routing rule `route=eu-west-1->eu-west-2:overload` to reduce load. Applying change to routing-config: ``rb set route hosted-eu prefer eu-west-2 50%``

alice (manager): heads-up: support is seeing a handful of user reports about errors in the EU region. Are we mitigating? How long estimate?

carla (sre): failover changes applied, traffic shifting. Still seeing restarts on r-inf-05, but overall 5xx rate dropping from 4.8% -> 1.3% in the last 90s.

dave (eng-oncall): confirming: CDN and client routing see fewer errors; logs show fewer 502s after the route change. Keeping oncall until stable.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: secondary acknowledged by carla (sre) at 5067894350.

ben (infra): investigation: OOM triggered by memory leak in runtime v2.1.4 container (heap growth under long-running prefix caching). We have core dump on r-inf-05.

carla (sre): temporary mitigation idea: restart long-lived runtime process on remaining hosts to reclaim memory before we do a rolling deploy. Schedule a staggered restart to avoid thundering herd. Suggested command: ``for h in r-inf-{03,04,06,07}; do ssh $h 'systemctl restart gpt-runtime' & sleep 15; done``

alice (manager): please coordinate restarts carefully. Customer impact note: support reports ~120 distinct user requests failed between 02:14-02:22 UTC (mostly short-lived), SLA risk low but visible. Keep updates for post-incident email.

ben (infra): doing staggered restarts now. Restart r-inf-03 -> ok. r-inf-04 -> ok. r-inf-06 -> ok. r-inf-07 -> ok.

carla (sre): after restarts and routing change, 5xx rate steady at 0.4% over 5m. Redis cache hit ratio unchanged.

dave (eng-oncall): should we cut traffic back to eu-west-1 now or keep weighted split for 15m to monitor?

carla (sre): keep split for 15m. If error rate <0.5% for 15m, we revert to full eu-west-1.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: auto-escalation timer canceled (incident acknowledged).

alice (manager): good work. Next steps: rollback runtime to v2.1.3 or patch v2.1.5 with leak fix? What's safer short-term?

ben (infra): short-term: roll back to v2.1.3 in eu-west-1 only and schedule a controlled deploy of 2.1.5 with leak fix after functional tests. Rollback command queued: ``deploy --cluster eu-west-1 --service gpt-runtime --to v2.1.3 --strategy rolling``

carla (sre): initiating rollback to v2.1.3 on eu-west-1. Will monitor.

dave (eng-oncall): monitoring metrics and traces; tracing shows KV cache mem growth correlated with runtime build.

carla (sre): rollback complete on all hosts. Post-rollback 5xx rate at 0.1% for last 5m.

alice (manager): please capture customer-impact summary for comms: include request counts, error window, affected endpoints, approximate user surface (EU production).

carla (sre): summary for post-incident: "Impact: ~2% of EU requests experienced 5xx between 02:14-02:22 UTC (~120 failed requests). Root cause: memory leak in runtime v2.1.4 causing OOMs and container restarts on r-inf-05 leading to elevated errors. Mitigation: weighted routing to eu-west-2, staggered restarts, rollback to v2.1.3. Current status: service healthy, monitoring for flakiness for 30m."

ben (infra): created JIRA INF-1109 to track permanent fix + postmortem.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9921 resolved (ack cleared) at 5067894383 by carla (sre).

carla (sre): closing loop — I’ll own the postmortem draft. If anyone has logs/traces to attach, ping me.

dave (eng-oncall): thumbs. Back to regular ops.

alice (manager): thanks everyone. Please add timeline and comms draft to INF-1109.
